下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
與國際聯盟相比，聯合國在結構上的一項重要改進是甚麼？
hist_fl_pw02.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Compared with the League of Nations, what was an important structural improvement in the United Nations?
hist_fl_pw02.explanation:
國際聯盟的兩項結構弱點，一是美國始終未加入、其後多國退出，二是重要決議須全體一致，令任何一國即可癱瘓議程。聯合國在這兩點上作出調整：主要大國自始參與，而安理會可依多數決通過集體行動，不再要求全體一致。須注意的是，聯合國並未取消大國特權，反而以否決權將其制度化；亦從無自己的常備軍隊，維和部隊須由成員國提供。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_pw02.explanationEn:
The League had two structural weaknesses: the United States never joined and several states later withdrew, and important decisions required unanimity, so any one state could stall proceedings. The UN adjusted on both counts — the major powers took part from the start, and the Security Council can resolve on collective action by majority rather than unanimity. Note that the UN did not abolish great-power privilege but institutionalised it as the veto, and it has never had a standing army: peacekeeping troops must be supplied by member states.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 蘇聯當時正杯葛安理會會議而未有出席行使否決權
該項決議已預先取得全體常任理事國的一致贊成
該項決議屬程序事項而毋須安理會通過
蘇聯經權衡之後投票贊成該項決議
optionsEn: The Soviet Union was boycotting the Council at the time and so was not present to use its veto
The resolution had secured the unanimous prior agreement of all permanent members
The resolution was procedural and needed no Council approval
After weighing the matter the Soviet Union voted in favour
hist_fl_pw04.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
韓戰爆發初期，安全理事會之所以能夠通過組成聯合國軍的決議，主要原因是甚麼？
hist_fl_pw04.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
At the start of the Korean War, why was the Security Council able to pass a resolution forming a United Nations force?
hist_fl_pw04.explanation:
此事最能說明否決權在實際運作中的關鍵作用。按常規，蘇聯必然否決此類決議；但蘇聯當時因中國代表權問題杯葛安理會，缺席之下決議得以通過。這既顯示制度設計的效力取決於各方是否在場行使權利，亦解釋了何以此後同類的集體行動極為罕見 ——蘇聯此後不再重複同一做法。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_pw04.explanationEn:
This episode shows the practical weight of the veto more clearly than any other. In the ordinary course the Soviet Union would certainly have blocked such a resolution; but it was then boycotting the Council over the question of Chinese representation, and in its absence the resolution passed. This illustrates that the effectiveness of an institutional design depends on whether parties are present to exercise their rights, and it explains why comparable collective action has been rare since — the Soviet Union did not repeat the tactic.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 雙方在核戰邊緣仍保留溝通渠道並願意尋求妥協
聯合國以決議成功強制雙方同時撤走軍備
雙方經此一役已完全消除彼此之間的敵意
美蘇隨即簽訂全面裁減核武器的正式條約
optionsEn: Even at the brink of nuclear war the two sides kept channels open and were willing to compromise
A UN resolution successfully compelled both to withdraw
The episode removed all hostility between the two sides
The two powers at once signed a comprehensive nuclear disarmament treaty
hist_fl_pw05.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
古巴導彈危機最終得以化解，反映冷戰時期的一項重要特點是甚麼？
hist_fl_pw05.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The resolution of the Cuban Missile Crisis reflects what important feature of the Cold War?
hist_fl_pw05.explanation:
此次危機的意義，在於它顯示雙方雖然全面敵對，卻同時明白核戰爭並無勝方，因而在最緊張的時刻仍維持接觸並各自作出讓步。危機之後雙方設立直接通訊聯繫，正是把這次經驗制度化。須避免兩種誤讀：一是以為敵意就此消除 —— 對抗其後持續數十年；二是把功勞歸於聯合國 —— 化解主要靠美蘇之間的直接交涉。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_pw05.explanationEn:
The significance of the crisis is that it showed the two sides, for all their hostility, both understood that a nuclear war would have no winner, and so maintained contact and each made concessions at the tensest moment. The direct communications link established afterwards institutionalised that lesson. Two misreadings should be avoided: that hostility ended — the confrontation continued for decades — and that the UN deserves the credit, when resolution came chiefly through direct dealings between the two powers.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 須經有關方面同意並依賴成員國提供部隊，故難以強制執行
依據憲章規定只可在歐洲地區範圍內行動
每次行動均須經全體會員國一致通過之後方可正式展開
自成立以來從未實際派出過任何維和部隊
optionsEn: It requires the consent of the parties and depends on troops contributed by member states, so it cannot readily enforce
Under the Charter it may operate only within Europe
Each operation may formally begin only after unanimous approval by all member states
It has never actually deployed any peacekeeping troops
hist_fl_pw06.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
聯合國維持和平行動的一項固有限制是甚麼？
hist_fl_pw06.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What is an inherent limitation of United Nations peacekeeping operations?
hist_fl_pw06.explanation:
維和行動的限制源於其性質：它建基於當事方的同意，且所有部隊均由成員國自願提供，聯合國本身並無可調動的常備武力。故當一方不再合作、或成員國不願派兵時，行動即難以推進。這說明維和機制較適用於監督已達成的停火，而非強行終止進行中的戰鬥 ——把兩者混為一談，往往是評價維和成效時失準的起點。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_pw06.explanationEn:
The limitation follows from the nature of the instrument: it rests on the consent of the parties, and all troops are volunteered by member states, the UN having no standing force of its own to deploy. When one party stops cooperating, or contributors decline to send troops, an operation stalls. This is why peacekeeping suits the supervision of a ceasefire already agreed rather than the forcible halting of fighting in progress — conflating the two is usually where assessments of peacekeeping go wrong.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 它既提供各國表達立場與協商的場合，其決議亦受大國實力關係所左右
它完全獨立於成員國的意志之外，可自行作出決策並直接付諸執行
它可以直接統治成員國，並凌駕於各國法律之上
它的唯一功能是舉辦會議，並不產生任何實際效果
optionsEn: It provides a forum for states to state positions and negotiate, while its decisions are shaped by the balance of power among the major states
It is wholly independent of member states’ wishes and can reach decisions and implement them directly
It can govern member states directly and override their laws
Its only function is to hold meetings, with no practical effect whatever
hist_fl_pw07.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
有評論指聯合國「既是舞台，也是工具」。此說最恰當的理解是甚麼？
hist_fl_pw07.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
It has been said that the UN is "both a stage and an instrument". What is the most appropriate reading of this?
hist_fl_pw07.explanation:
「舞台」指其作為公開場合的功能：各國須在此表態，而表態本身即產生外交後果，即使議案未獲通過。「工具」則指其決議可被用以推進特定國家的目標，故決議內容往往反映當時的實力對比。兩者並不矛盾，而是同一機構的兩面。把聯合國理解為超然於成員國之上的權威，或反過來貶為純粹的清談場所，都只看到其中一面。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_pw07.explanationEn:
The "stage" refers to its function as a public forum: states must take positions there, and doing so has diplomatic consequences even when a motion fails. The "instrument" refers to the way resolutions can be used to advance particular states’ aims, so their content often reflects the prevailing balance of power. The two are not in conflict but are two faces of the same body. Treating the UN as an authority standing above its members, or dismissing it as a mere talking shop, each sees only one side.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 由以轉口貿易為主轉向以製造業為主
由以漁業為主轉向以農業為主
由以農業為主轉向以轉口貿易為主
由以製造業為主轉向以金融服務為主
optionsEn: From an economy centred on entrepôt trade to one centred on manufacturing
hist_fl_hk01.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
香港在 1950 年代經濟結構的主要轉變是甚麼？
hist_fl_hk01.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What was the main change in Hong Kong’s economic structure during the 1950s?
hist_fl_hk01.explanation:
香港長期以轉口貿易為經濟支柱。1950 年代初對外貿易環境變化，轉口業務大幅收縮，本地遂轉向製造業，以紡織製衣為先導，逐步發展出以出口為導向的工業體系。此一轉變之所以可能，與同期大量人口南遷所帶來的勞動力及資金有直接關係。須留意由製造業轉向金融服務屬 1980 年代之後的事，兩次轉型不可混為一談。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_hk01.explanationEn:
Hong Kong had long depended on entrepôt trade. External trading conditions changed in the early 1950s and entrepôt business contracted sharply, so the territory turned to manufacturing, led by textiles and garments and developing into an export-oriented industrial system. This shift was made possible in large part by the labour and capital brought by the large-scale migration of the same period. Note that the move from manufacturing to financial services belongs to the period after the 1980s; the two transitions should not be conflated.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 開始大規模興建徙置屋邨，由政府直接介入房屋供應
全面禁止內地人士入境以控制人口進一步增加
即時推行免費普及教育以取代原有的學費制度
開始徵收利得稅以填補救災所造成的財政缺口
optionsEn: It began building resettlement estates on a large scale, intervening directly in housing provision
It banned entry from the mainland outright to curb further population growth
It introduced free universal education at once, replacing school fees
It began levying profits tax to cover the fiscal gap left by relief
hist_fl_hk02.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
1953 年石硤尾寮屋區大火之後，港英政府在政策上出現的重要轉變是甚麼？
hist_fl_hk02.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
After the Shek Kip Mei squatter fire of 1953, what important shift occurred in colonial government policy?
hist_fl_hk02.explanation:
大火令數萬人一夜之間失去居所，政府原本盡量不介入房屋市場的立場因而難以維持，遂展開徙置屋邨的興建，此為香港公營房屋制度的起點。此事的意義不止於房屋本身 ——它標誌著政府角色由消極轉為主動介入社會事務。免費普及教育屬 1970 年代之後的政策，兩者相隔約二十年，不應歸於同一事件的後果。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_hk02.explanationEn:
The fire left tens of thousands homeless overnight, making the government’s preference for staying out of the housing market untenable, and it began constructing resettlement estates — the origin of Hong Kong’s public housing system. The significance goes beyond housing itself: it marks a shift in the government’s role from passive to active intervention in social affairs. Free universal education belongs to the 1970s, some two decades later, and should not be attributed to this event.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 社會事件之後管治壓力上升，同時經濟增長提供了財政條件
香港人口在該十年間因外移而大幅下降
英國政府決定即時給予香港獨立，並已着手安排政權交接
中英兩國當時已就香港前途問題達成協議
optionsEn: Governing pressure had risen after social unrest, while economic growth provided the fiscal means
Hong Kong’s population fell sharply that decade through emigration
Britain had decided to grant Hong Kong immediate independence and begun arranging the handover
Britain and China had by then agreed on Hong Kong’s future
hist_fl_hk03.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
1970 年代港英政府推行多項社會改革（房屋、教育、廉政等），其背景包括甚麼？
hist_fl_hk03.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The colonial government introduced a series of social reforms in the 1970s (housing, education, anti-corruption). What was the background?
hist_fl_hk03.explanation:
1970 年代的改革須同時由兩方面理解。一方面，1960 年代的社會事件暴露了管治與民生上的積累問題，令政府面對回應訴求的壓力；另一方面，經濟持續增長使庫房有能力承擔大規模社會開支 ——缺少後者，改革即使有意亦難以落實。須注意中英就香港前途的談判始於 1980 年代，在時序上不能作為 1970 年代改革的背景。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_hk03.explanationEn:
The reforms of the 1970s must be understood from two directions at once. On one side, the social unrest of the 1960s exposed accumulated problems of governance and livelihood and put the government under pressure to respond. On the other, sustained economic growth gave the treasury the capacity to carry large social expenditure — without which reform would have been hard to deliver however willing the intent. Note that Sino-British negotiations over Hong Kong’s future began in the 1980s and cannot, chronologically, form the background to reforms of the 1970s.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 公營部門貪污嚴重，而既有的內部監察機制未能奏效
教育水平偏低而未能配合工業發展所需
政府稅收長期不足，未能支持房屋與教育等各項開支
房屋供應嚴重短缺而輪候時間不斷延長
optionsEn: Serious corruption in the public sector, which existing internal supervision had failed to check
Educational standards were too low for industrial development
Government revenue was persistently too low to support housing, education and other expenditure
Housing supply fell far short and waiting times kept lengthening
hist_fl_hk04.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
總督特派廉政專員公署於 1974 年成立，其設立所針對的核心問題是甚麼？
hist_fl_hk04.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The Independent Commission Against Corruption was set up in 1974. What core problem was it created to address?
hist_fl_hk04.explanation:
成立廉署的關鍵，不僅在於當時貪污嚴重，更在於原先由警隊內部處理貪污的安排已失去公信力。故新機構的設計重點是【獨立於既有部門之外】、直接向總督負責，此一制度安排本身即是對舊機制失效的回應。房屋與教育在同期亦屬重大課題，但各有其專責部門與政策，並非廉署的設立目的。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_hk04.explanationEn:
What mattered was not only that corruption was serious but that the existing arrangement — handling corruption within the police force itself — had lost credibility. The new body was therefore designed to sit outside the existing departments and report directly to the Governor; that institutional arrangement was itself the response to the failure of the old mechanism. Housing and education were also major issues of the period, but each had its own departments and policies and was not the purpose for which the Commission was established.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 本地製造業就業萎縮，服務業所佔比重上升
本地人口因就業機會減少而大幅下降
本地製造業與服務業兩者同時大幅萎縮
本地轉口貿易自此完全停止而不再恢復
optionsEn: Manufacturing employment shrank while the share of services rose
The population fell sharply as employment opportunities shrank
Both manufacturing and services contracted sharply at the same time
Entrepôt trade stopped entirely and never resumed
hist_fl_hk05.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
香港自 1980 年代起工業北移，對本地經濟結構的主要影響是甚麼？
hist_fl_hk05.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
From the 1980s Hong Kong’s industry relocated northward. What was the main effect on the local economic structure?
hist_fl_hk05.explanation:
工業生產環節北移之後，本地製造業職位大幅減少，而與生產相關的管理、金融、貿易及物流等服務需求則相應增加，服務業比重因而上升。值得注意的是，轉口貿易並未消失，反而因兩地分工而重新活躍 ——香港轉為承擔貿易、融資與航運的角色。故此一轉變並非「衰落」，而是分工位置的改變。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_hk05.explanationEn:
With production relocated, local manufacturing jobs fell sharply, while demand rose for the management, financial, trading and logistics services that production required, raising the share of services. Notably, entrepôt trade did not disappear but revived under the new division of labour, with Hong Kong taking on trading, financing and shipping roles. The change was therefore not a decline but a shift in position within that division of labour.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 多項政策在社會壓力或危機之後推出，兼具回應訴求與穩定管治的作用
所有政策均由英國政府直接指令推行，本地官員完全並無參與制定
政策推行之後對一般市民毫無任何實際的幫助
政策全部由商界主導制定，政府只負責執行程序
optionsEn: Several policies followed social pressure or crisis and served both to meet demands and to stabilise governance
Every policy was imposed by direct instruction from London, with local officials playing no part whatever in framing it
The policies brought ordinary residents no practical benefit at all
Policies were entirely shaped by business, with government merely executing
hist_fl_hk06.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
有論者認為，戰後香港的社會政策發展並非單純出於施政善意。此說的主要依據是甚麼？
hist_fl_hk06.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Some argue that post-war social policy in Hong Kong did not arise simply from benevolent intent. What is the main ground for this view?
hist_fl_hk06.explanation:
此一論點的依據在於政策推出的時序：公營房屋始於一場大火之後，多項社會改革繼社會事件而來，廉署則在管治威信受質疑之際成立。這種「事件在前、政策在後」的規律，顯示政策同時具有回應訴求與鞏固管治的雙重作用。須留意此說並非否定政策的實際成效 ——指出動機複雜，與承認市民確有得益，兩者並不矛盾；把「動機不純」推論為「毫無幫助」，反而是另一種簡化。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_hk06.explanationEn:
The ground for this view is the sequence in which policies appeared: public housing followed a fire, a series of social reforms followed unrest, and the anti-corruption commission was created when the credibility of governance was in question. This pattern of event first, policy after, indicates that the policies served both to answer demands and to consolidate rule. Note that the argument does not deny the policies’ practical effects — observing that motives were mixed is compatible with acknowledging real benefit to the public, and inferring "no benefit at all" from "impure motive" is simply another oversimplification.

hist_fl_se01.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
第二次世界大戰之前，東南亞唯一未曾淪為歐美殖民地的國家是哪一個？
hist_fl_se01.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Which was the only Southeast Asian country never to become a European or American colony before the Second World War?
hist_fl_se01.explanation:
泰國得以維持形式上的獨立，主要因其位處英國與法國兩大殖民勢力範圍之間，成為雙方之間的緩衝地帶，同時其統治者亦主動推行改革並在外交上作出讓步。須留意「未淪為殖民地」不等於未受影響 ——泰國仍曾割讓邊緣領土並簽訂不平等條約。越南由法國統治，印尼由荷蘭統治，菲律賓則先後受西班牙及美國統治。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_se01.explanationEn:
Thailand retained formal independence largely because it lay between the British and French spheres and served as a buffer between them, while its rulers also pursued reform and made diplomatic concessions. Note that escaping colonisation did not mean escaping its effects: Thailand still ceded peripheral territory and signed unequal treaties. Vietnam was ruled by France and Indonesia by the Netherlands, while the Philippines was ruled first by Spain and then by the United States.

令歐美殖民統治的威信在戰後反而更為鞏固
使各地既有的獨立運動在佔領期間完全停頓，戰後須由頭重新組織
對戰後各地的獨立運動並無產生任何實質影響

It left the prestige of European colonial rule stronger after the war
It halted existing independence movements entirely during the occupation, so they had to be organised afresh after the war
It had no substantive effect on post-war independence movements
hist_fl_se02.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
日本於第二次世界大戰期間佔領東南亞，對戰後該區獨立運動的影響是甚麼？
hist_fl_se02.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What effect did the Japanese occupation of Southeast Asia during the Second World War have on post-war independence movements?
hist_fl_se02.explanation:
日本迅速擊敗當地歐美殖民軍隊，在觀感上瓦解了殖民統治不可動搖的印象；佔領期間為便於統治而扶植的本地組織與武裝，亦在戰後成為獨立運動的骨幹。須同時指出，日本佔領本身亦施行嚴苛統治並造成重大苦難，故其作用是客觀後果而非主觀恩惠 ——把它說成「協助獨立」是嚴重的誤讀。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_se02.explanationEn:
Japan’s rapid defeat of the European colonial forces destroyed the impression that colonial rule was unshakeable, and the local organisations and armed units fostered during the occupation for administrative convenience became the backbone of post-war independence movements. It must equally be said that the occupation itself was harsh and caused great suffering, so this was an objective consequence rather than a favour conferred — reading it as "helping independence" badly misstates the case.

options: 荷蘭試圖恢復殖民統治，雙方發生武裝衝突及外交角力
聯合國明確反對印尼獨立並拒絕承認其地位
日本拒絕依約撤出印尼並繼續維持軍事佔領
印尼社會內部並無獨立意願，宣言只屬少數人主張
optionsEn: The Netherlands sought to restore colonial rule, leading to armed conflict and diplomatic struggle
The UN expressly opposed Indonesian independence and refused recognition
Japan refused to withdraw as agreed and maintained its military occupation
There was no desire for independence in Indonesian society; the declaration was a minority position
hist_fl_se03.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
印尼於 1945 年宣布獨立後仍須經歷數年鬥爭方獲承認，主要原因是甚麼？
hist_fl_se03.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Indonesia declared independence in 1945 but had to struggle for several more years before it was recognised. What was the main reason?
hist_fl_se03.explanation:
日本投降後，印尼隨即宣布獨立，但荷蘭並不承認，並試圖以武力重建殖民統治，雙方遂爆發長達數年的武裝衝突。最終促成承認的並非單一因素，而是本地持續抵抗加上國際輿論與外交壓力共同作用的結果。此例說明「宣布獨立」與「取得獨立」之間往往有相當距離 ——前者是單方面聲明，後者須有實力與外部承認為支撐。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_se03.explanationEn:
Indonesia declared independence immediately after Japan’s surrender, but the Netherlands did not recognise it and sought to rebuild colonial rule by force, producing several years of armed conflict. Recognition eventually came not from any single factor but from sustained local resistance combined with international opinion and diplomatic pressure. The case shows how far apart declaring independence and achieving it can be: the first is a unilateral statement, the second requires both capacity and external recognition.

options: 建立統一的國家認同、整合多元族群，以及發展本國經濟
完全沒有可供出口的資源，難以賺取外匯
人口過少而勞動力不足，難以支撐獨立後的工業發展
缺乏任何形式的行政體系，須由零開始建立
optionsEn: Building a unified national identity, integrating diverse ethnic groups, and developing the economy
They had no exportable resources at all with which to earn foreign exchange
Populations were too small and labour too scarce to sustain industrial development after independence
They lacked any administrative system and had to build one from nothing
hist_fl_se04.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
東南亞國家獨立之後普遍面對的共同課題包括甚麼？
hist_fl_se04.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What challenges did Southeast Asian states commonly face after independence?
hist_fl_se04.explanation:
殖民時期所劃定的疆界往往不按族群或歷史脈絡而定，故新國家內部普遍存在多元族群與宗教，如何建立共同的國家認同成為首要課題。同時，殖民經濟多以出口單一初級產品為主，獨立後須調整此一結構方能自立。須注意殖民統治確實留下了行政體系與基礎建設，問題在於這些體制原為殖民管治而設，未必切合獨立國家的需要 —— 這與「完全沒有」是兩回事。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_se04.explanationEn:
Colonial borders were often drawn without regard to ethnic or historical lines, so the new states generally contained diverse peoples and religions, making the construction of a shared national identity the first task. Colonial economies had also been geared to exporting a single primary commodity, a structure that had to be altered if the state was to stand on its own. Note that colonial rule did leave administrative systems and infrastructure behind; the difficulty was that these had been built for colonial administration and did not necessarily suit an independent state — which is not the same as their being absent altogether.

options: 在冷戰格局之下促進區內合作與穩定，減少外部勢力介入
把各成員國逐步合併成為一個單一的聯邦國家
統一各成員國的貨幣，以建立單一的區內市場
組成一個共同的軍事同盟，以便一致參與冷戰對抗
optionsEn: To promote regional cooperation and stability under Cold War conditions and reduce outside interference
To merge the members step by step into a single federal state
To unify members’ currencies and create a single regional market
To form a joint military alliance so as to take part in the Cold War together
hist_fl_se05.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
東南亞國家聯盟於 1967 年成立時的主要考慮是甚麼？
hist_fl_se05.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What was the principal consideration behind the founding of ASEAN in 1967?
hist_fl_se05.explanation:
東盟成立於冷戰高峰期，區內衝突不斷、外部勢力介入頻繁。創始成員的共同考慮，是透過區域合作減低彼此摩擦，並在大國角力之間保持一定自主。故其初期性質是政治協商多於經濟整合，亦刻意避免成為軍事同盟 ——正因結成同盟便等於選邊，反而會把區域捲入對抗。貨幣統一與國家合併從不在其目標之列。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_se05.explanationEn:
ASEAN was founded at the height of the Cold War, when regional conflict was frequent and outside intervention common. Its founders’ shared aim was to reduce friction among themselves through regional cooperation and to preserve some autonomy amid great-power rivalry. Its early character was therefore political consultation rather than economic integration, and it deliberately avoided becoming a military alliance — since forming one would have meant taking sides and drawing the region further into the confrontation. Currency union and political merger were never among its aims.

各國均經歷長期武裝鬥爭之後方才取得獨立
各國均以和平談判的方式，從原宗主國手中順利取得完整獨立
各國均在戰後同一年之內先後宣告獨立

All obtained full independence smoothly from their former metropoles through peaceful negotiation

hist_fl_se06.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
比較東南亞各國的獨立過程，一個較準確的概括是甚麼？
hist_fl_se06.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Comparing the independence processes of Southeast Asian states, which is the more accurate generalisation?
hist_fl_se06.explanation:
比較題的關鍵，在於辨別哪些是共同之處、哪些是差異。各國的共同點在於同處去殖民化的大潮之中；差異則在於過程 ——宗主國是否願意撤出、本地是否已有組織化的政治或武裝力量、以及冷戰形勢是否令外部勢力介入，三者組合不同，結果由相對和平的權力移交到長期戰爭皆有。凡以「均」、「全部」概括一組差異甚大的個案，通常都是可以被反例推翻的。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_fl_se06.explanationEn:
The key to a comparison question is distinguishing what was shared from what differed. What these states shared was being caught up in the same wave of decolonisation; what differed was the process — whether the metropole was willing to withdraw, whether organised political or armed forces already existed locally, and whether Cold War conditions drew in outside powers. Different combinations produced outcomes ranging from relatively peaceful transfers of power to prolonged war. Generalisations using "all" across a set of markedly different cases can usually be overturned by counter-example.

hisb_ca1_1870_1911.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一份教科書把某場戰爭的【根源】定在 1870 年的一項結構性變化，把【導火線】定在 1911 年的一宗突發事件。兩者相隔多少年？
hisb_ca1_1870_1911.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A textbook dates the ROOT CAUSE of a war to a structural change in 1870 and its TRIGGER to a sudden event in 1911. How many years apart are they?
hisb_ca1_1870_1911.explanation:
$1911 - 1870 = 41$ 年。這 41 年正是理解因果的關鍵：【導火線】只解釋戰爭為何在那一刻爆發，【根源】才解釋為何早已具備爆發的條件。把兩者混為一談，會得出「若無那宗事件便無戰爭」這個站不住的結論 —— 因為結構性條件仍在，換一宗事件一樣會引爆。答題時必須分開處理這兩層。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_ca1_1870_1911.explanationEn:
$1911 - 1870 = 41$ years. Those 41 years are the crux of causal reasoning: the TRIGGER explains only why war broke out at that moment, while the ROOT CAUSE explains why the conditions for war were already in place. Conflating them yields the untenable claim that without that one event there would have been no war — the structural conditions remained, and another spark would have served. Answers must keep the two layers apart.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

一份教科書把某場戰爭的【根源】定在 1870 年的一項結構性變化，把【導火線】定在 1931 年的一宗突發事件。兩者相隔多少年？
hisb_ca1_1870_1931.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A textbook dates the ROOT CAUSE of a war to a structural change in 1870 and its TRIGGER to a sudden event in 1931. How many years apart are they?
hisb_ca1_1870_1931.explanation:
$1931 - 1870 = 61$ 年。這 61 年正是理解因果的關鍵：【導火線】只解釋戰爭為何在那一刻爆發，【根源】才解釋為何早已具備爆發的條件。把兩者混為一談，會得出「若無那宗事件便無戰爭」這個站不住的結論 —— 因為結構性條件仍在，換一宗事件一樣會引爆。答題時必須分開處理這兩層。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_ca1_1870_1931.explanationEn:
$1931 - 1870 = 61$ years. Those 61 years are the crux of causal reasoning: the TRIGGER explains only why war broke out at that moment, while the ROOT CAUSE explains why the conditions for war were already in place. Conflating them yields the untenable claim that without that one event there would have been no war — the structural conditions remained, and another spark would have served. Answers must keep the two layers apart.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

剩餘 $100\% - 30\% = 70\%$，分予 2 項，每項 $70 \div 2 = 35\%$。⚠️ 這種百分比【只是表達重點的方式，不是可量度的事實】—— 歷史因果無法像實驗那樣分離變項。史家給出權重，是在陳述一個【可被質疑的判斷】，而評卷要求的正是說明為何如此排序，不是背誦排序本身。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=1.817（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_ca2_3_30.explanationEn:
The remainder is $100\% - 30\% = 70\%$ shared by 2 factors, giving $70 \div 2 = 35\%$ each. NOTE such percentages are A WAY OF EXPRESSING EMPHASIS, NOT MEASURABLE FACT — historical causation cannot isolate variables as an experiment can. hisb_sg1_1911_3.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一項研究把某 1911 年事件的影響分為短期與長期，並以事件後 3 年為分界。該分界落在哪一年？
hisb_sg1_1911_3.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A study divides the impact of an event of 1911 into short and long term, setting the boundary 3 years after the event. In which year does the boundary fall?
hisb_sg1_1911_3.explanation:
$1911 + 3 = 1914$ 年。⚠️ 這條界線【由研究者自行劃定】，並非史實本身具有的性質。同一事件用五年與用五十年去看，結論可以完全相反 —— 短期看似災難的，長期可能是制度轉型的起點；短期看似勝利的，長期可能埋下下一場衝突。所以評價影響時，必須先交代【用甚麼時間尺度】。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_sg1_1911_3.explanationEn:
$1911 + 3 = 1914$. NOTE this boundary is SET BY THE RESEARCHER and is not a property of the past itself. Viewed over five years or over fifty, the same event can yield opposite conclusions — what looks like catastrophe in the short run may begin institutional change, and what looks like victory may seed the next conflict. Any evaluation of impact must therefore state the TIME SCALE it uses.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_w1_1911_1917.content:

一場戰事由 1911 年某月持續至 1917 年同月。以整年計，該戰事歷時多少個月？
hisb_w1_1911_1917.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A campaign runs from a month in 1911 to the same month in 1917. Counting whole years, how many months did it last?
hisb_w1_1911_1917.explanation:
$(1917 - 1911) \times 12 = 72$ 個月。第一次世界大戰之所以被稱為現代戰爭的分水嶺，關鍵不在長度而在【性質】：工業化生產令戰爭可以持續數年而不崩潰，鐵路與徵兵制令整個社會被動員。戰爭由「軍隊之間的事」變成「國家之間的總體戰」，這個轉變比任何一場戰役都重要。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_w1_1911_1917.explanationEn:
$(1917 - 1911) \times 12 = 72$ months. What made the First World War a watershed was not its length but its CHARACTER: industrial production let war continue for years without collapse, while railways and conscription mobilised whole societies. War shifted from an affair between armies to total war between nations, and that shift matters more than any single battle.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

一場戰事由 1915 年某月持續至 1922 年同月。以整年計，該戰事歷時多少個月？
hisb_w1_1915_1922.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A campaign runs from a month in 1915 to the same month in 1922. Counting whole years, how many months did it last?
hisb_w1_1915_1922.explanation:
$(1922 - 1915) \times 12 = 84$ 個月。第一次世界大戰之所以被稱為現代戰爭的分水嶺，關鍵不在長度而在【性質】：工業化生產令戰爭可以持續數年而不崩潰，鐵路與徵兵制令整個社會被動員。戰爭由「軍隊之間的事」變成「國家之間的總體戰」，這個轉變比任何一場戰役都重要。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_w1_1915_1922.explanationEn:
$(1922 - 1915) \times 12 = 84$ months. What made the First World War a watershed was not its length but its CHARACTER: industrial production let war continue for years without collapse, while railways and conscription mobilised whole societies. War shifted from an affair between armies to total war between nations, and that shift matters more than any single battle.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_di1_300_25.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一個議會共 300 席，某黨取得 25%（即 75 席）。距離單獨過半（151 席）尚欠多少席？
hisb_di1_300_25.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A parliament has 300 seats and a party wins 25% of them, that is 75. How many seats short of an outright majority of 151 is it?
hisb_di1_300_25.explanation:
尚欠 $151 - 75 = 76$ 席。⚠️ 極權政體的興起【往往不是靠選舉取得多數】，而是靠在未過半的情況下取得組閣權，再以行政手段逐步取消制衡：緊急權力、政黨禁令、新聞管制。所以研究極權興起要看的不是得票率，而是【制度上有哪些關卡失守】，以及為何當時的政治精英認為可以控制局面。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_di1_300_25.explanationEn:
The shortfall is $151 - 75 = 76$ seats. NOTE that authoritarian regimes typically arise WITHOUT WINNING A MAJORITY: they secure office short of one, then dismantle the checks by administrative means — emergency powers, bans on parties, control of the press. Studying their rise therefore means examining WHICH INSTITUTIONAL SAFEGUARDS GAVE WAY, and why the political elite of the day believed the situation could be managed.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_w2_1931_1943.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一份年表記載某地由 1931 年被佔領至 1943 年結束。佔領期歷時多少年？
hisb_w2_1931_1943.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A chronology records a territory under occupation from 1931 until 1943. How many years did the occupation last?
hisb_w2_1931_1943.explanation:
$1943 - 1931 = 12$ 年。研究佔領期不能只數年份 —— 同樣是 12 年，行政體制被完全取代、抑或保留原有官僚而換上新的頂層，戰後的重建路徑會完全不同。前者要從零重建制度，後者則面對「原有人員是否清算」這個更棘手的問題。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_w2_1931_1943.explanationEn:
$1943 - 1931 = 12$ years. Studying an occupation means more than counting years — over the same 12 years, whether the administration was wholly replaced or the existing bureaucracy retained under new leadership sets entirely different paths for post-war reconstruction. The first must rebuild institutions from nothing; the second faces the harder question of whether to purge those who stayed.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

一份年表記載某地由 1931 年被佔領至 1945 年結束。佔領期歷時多少年？
hisb_w2_1931_1945.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A chronology records a territory under occupation from 1931 until 1945. How many years did the occupation last?
hisb_w2_1931_1945.explanation:
$1945 - 1931 = 14$ 年。研究佔領期不能只數年份 —— 同樣是 14 年，行政體制被完全取代、抑或保留原有官僚而換上新的頂層，戰後的重建路徑會完全不同。前者要從零重建制度，後者則面對「原有人員是否清算」這個更棘手的問題。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_w2_1931_1945.explanationEn:
$1945 - 1931 = 14$ years. Studying an occupation means more than counting years — over the same 14 years, whether the administration was wholly replaced or the existing bureaucracy retained under new leadership sets entirely different paths for post-war reconstruction. The first must rebuild institutions from nothing; the second faces the harder question of whether to purge those who stayed.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_cw1_1943_1985.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一份研究把某段兩極對峙由 1943 年計至 1985 年。該段對峙歷時多少年？
hisb_cw1_1943_1985.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A study dates a period of bipolar confrontation from 1943 to 1985. How many years did it last?
hisb_cw1_1943_1985.explanation:
$1985 - 1943 = 42$ 年，約 2 個世代。⚠️ 起訖年份【本身就是一個論點】：把起點定在戰爭結束抑或定在某項政策宣布，反映的是研究者認為對峙由何而起。同理，終點定在圍牆倒下抑或定在國家解體，反映的是他認為對峙結束於象徵事件抑或制度終結。看見不同教科書給出不同年份，第一個問題應該是「他為甚麼這樣劃」。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_cw1_1943_1985.explanationEn:
$1985 - 1943 = 42$ years, roughly 2 generations. NOTE the start and end dates ARE THEMSELVES AN ARGUMENT: placing the start at the end of a war or at a policy announcement reveals what the writer thinks began the confrontation, just as ending it at a wall's fall or at a state's dissolution reveals whether they see the close as symbolic or institutional. When textbooks disagree on dates, the first question is why each drew the line where it did.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

A chronology dates a reform programme from 1860 to 1863. How many years does the phase span?
hisb_cm1_1860_3.explanation:
$1863 - 1860 = 3$ 年。評價一項改革不能只看年期長短，要看【改甚麼層次】：器物層（技術、裝備）、制度層（法制、組織）、觀念層（教育、思想）。只改器物而不動制度，往往在遇上真正考驗時失效 —— 這是理解近代中國多次改革成敗的一條主線。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_cm1_1860_3.explanationEn:
$1863 - 1860 = 3$ years. Judging a reform means asking not how long it ran but WHAT LEVEL IT CHANGED: material (technology and equipment), institutional (law and organisation), or intellectual (education and ideas). Reform confined to the material while institutions stay untouched tends to fail its first real test — a thread running through the successes and failures of modern Chinese reform.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_jm1_100_300_20.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一份統計顯示某項工業指標由 100 單位在 20 年間升至 300 單位。年均增加多少單位？
hisb_jm1_100_300_20.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A statistic shows an industrial index rising from 100 to 300 units over 20 years. What is the average annual increase, in units?
hisb_jm1_100_300_20.explanation:
年均 = $(300 - 100) \div 20 = 10$ 單位。⚠️ 年均值【假設增長平均分佈】，而現代化幾乎從不如此：初期投入基礎建設而產出未見，中期加速，後期放緩。把年均值當成每年實況，會錯過最關鍵的問題 —— 加速是在哪一段發生，以及那一段有甚麼制度條件在配合。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_jm1_100_300_20.explanationEn:
Annual average = $(300 - 100) \div 20 = 10$ units. NOTE an average ASSUMES EVEN GROWTH, which modernisation almost never shows: early years pour into infrastructure with little output, the middle accelerates, the late years slow. Reading the average as the annual reality misses the question that matters — when the acceleration happened, and what institutional conditions accompanied it.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_ic1_12_60.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一個國際組織有 12 個成員國，通過議案須取得 60% 成員支持。最少須有多少國支持？
hisb_ic1_12_60.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
An international organisation of 12 members requires 60% support to pass a motion. What is the minimum number of members needed?
hisb_ic1_12_60.explanation:
$12 \times 60\% = 7.2$，票數不能是小數，故【向上取整】為 8 國。⚠️ 表決門檻的高低是一種取捨：門檻低則決議易通過而易被多數強加於少數，門檻高則保障小國而容易陷入僵局。國際組織的成效，往往不取決於它有多少成員，而取決於【最強的成員願不願意受它約束】。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_ic1_12_60.explanationEn:
$12 \times 60\% = 7.2$, and votes cannot be fractional, so ROUND UP to 8. NOTE the threshold embodies a trade-off: a low bar passes resolutions easily but lets a majority impose on a minority, while a high bar protects small states and invites deadlock. What determines an international body's effectiveness is rarely its membership size but WHETHER ITS STRONGEST MEMBERS ACCEPT ITS CONSTRAINTS.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

一個國際組織有 40 個成員國，通過議案須取得 60% 成員支持。最少須有多少國支持？
hisb_ic1_40_60.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
An international organisation of 40 members requires 60% support to pass a motion. What is the minimum number of members needed?
hisb_ic1_40_60.explanation:
$40 \times 60\% = 24$，票數不能是小數，故【向上取整】為 24 國。⚠️ 表決門檻的高低是一種取捨：門檻低則決議易通過而易被多數強加於少數，門檻高則保障小國而容易陷入僵局。國際組織的成效，往往不取決於它有多少成員，而取決於【最強的成員願不願意受它約束】。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_ic1_40_60.explanationEn:
$40 \times 60\% = 24$, and votes cannot be fractional, so ROUND UP to 24. NOTE the threshold embodies a trade-off: a low bar passes resolutions easily but lets a majority impose on a minority, while a high bar protects small states and invites deadlock. What determines an international body's effectiveness is rarely its membership size but WHETHER ITS STRONGEST MEMBERS ACCEPT ITS CONSTRAINTS.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_hk1_600_2.content:

一份規劃文件假設某地 600 千人口，平均每個住宅單位居住 2 人。按此假設須提供多少千個單位？
hisb_hk1_600_2.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A planning document assumes a population of 600 thousand with an average of 2 persons per dwelling. How many thousand dwellings must be provided?
hisb_hk1_600_2.explanation:
$600 \div 2 = 300$ 千個單位。⚠️ 這條算式的假設本身就是政策：把每戶人數定在 2 人，等於預設了家庭結構不變。若家庭規模下降（子女減少、獨居增加），同樣人口需要的單位數會【上升】—— 用舊假設規劃新人口，是住屋供應長期落後的常見成因之一。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_hk1_600_2.explanationEn:
$600 \div 2 = 300$ thousand dwellings. NOTE the assumption is itself a policy: fixing household size at 2 presumes family structure will not change. If households shrink through fewer children and more single occupancy, the same population needs MORE dwellings — planning new populations on old assumptions is a standard reason housing supply falls behind.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

一份規劃文件假設某地 1500 千人口，平均每個住宅單位居住 2 人。按此假設須提供多少千個單位？
hisb_hk1_1500_2.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A planning document assumes a population of 1500 thousand with an average of 2 persons per dwelling. How many thousand dwellings must be provided?
hisb_hk1_1500_2.explanation:
$1500 \div 2 = 750$ 千個單位。⚠️ 這條算式的假設本身就是政策：把每戶人數定在 2 人，等於預設了家庭結構不變。若家庭規模下降（子女減少、獨居增加），同樣人口需要的單位數會【上升】—— 用舊假設規劃新人口，是住屋供應長期落後的常見成因之一。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_hk1_1500_2.explanationEn:
$1500 \div 2 = 750$ thousand dwellings. NOTE the assumption is itself a policy: fixing household size at 2 presumes family structure will not change. If households shrink through fewer children and more single occupancy, the same population needs MORE dwellings — planning new populations on old assumptions is a standard reason housing supply falls behind.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_se1_1511_1945.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一份年表記載某地由 1511 年起被外來勢力管治，至 1945 年獨立。該段管治歷時多少年？
hisb_se1_1511_1945.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A chronology records a territory under foreign rule from 1511 until independence in 1945. How many years did that rule last?
hisb_se1_1511_1945.explanation:
$1945 - 1511 = 434$ 年。⚠️ 獨立【不等於】殖民影響隨即結束：邊界的劃法、行政語言、教育制度、經濟作物的單一化，往往在獨立後仍然決定着國家的走向數十年。研究去殖民化，要問的是【哪些結構被保留下來】，而不只是政權何時易手。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_se1_1511_1945.explanationEn:
$1945 - 1511 = 434$ years. NOTE independence does NOT end colonial influence at a stroke: how borders were drawn, which language administers, how schooling is organised and how far the economy depends on a single crop continue to shape a country for decades afterwards. Studying decolonisation asks WHICH STRUCTURES SURVIVED, not merely when authority changed hands.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

A chronology records a territory under foreign rule from 1819 until independence in 1975. How many years did that rule last?
hisb_se1_1819_1975.explanation:
$1975 - 1819 = 156$ 年。⚠️ 獨立【不等於】殖民影響隨即結束：邊界的劃法、行政語言、教育制度、經濟作物的單一化，往往在獨立後仍然決定着國家的走向數十年。研究去殖民化，要問的是【哪些結構被保留下來】，而不只是政權何時易手。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_se1_1819_1975.explanationEn:
$1975 - 1819 = 156$ years. NOTE independence does NOT end colonial influence at a stroke: how borders were drawn, which language administers, how schooling is organised and how far the economy depends on a single crop continue to shape a country for decades afterwards. Studying decolonisation asks WHICH STRUCTURES SURVIVED, not merely when authority changed hands.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_pw1_2_4.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一支維持和平部隊共 2 千人，由 4 個國家平均派出。每國派出多少人？
hisb_pw1_2_4.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A peacekeeping force of 2 thousand is contributed equally by 4 countries. How many personnel does each provide?
hisb_pw1_2_4.explanation:
$2000 \div 4 = 500$ 人。⚠️ 維持和平行動的成效【不取決於人數】，而取決於三件事：是否取得衝突各方同意、任務授權是否清晰、以及有否政治解決方案在推進。缺了第三項，部隊只能凍結衝突而無法終止它 —— 這也是為何有些行動一駐就是數十年。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_pw1_2_4.explanationEn:
$2000 \div 4 = 500$ personnel. NOTE the effectiveness of peacekeeping does NOT rest on numbers but on three conditions: the consent of the parties, a clear mandate, and a political settlement being pursued alongside. Without the third, a force can only freeze a conflict rather than end it — which is why some deployments have lasted decades.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

A peacekeeping force of 2 thousand is contributed equally by 5 countries. How many personnel does each provide?

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_pw1_2_5.explanationEn:
$2000 \div 5 = 400$ personnel. NOTE the effectiveness of peacekeeping does NOT rest on numbers but on three conditions: the consent of the parties, a clear mandate, and a political settlement being pursued alongside. Without the third, a force can only freeze a conflict rather than end it — which is why some deployments have lasted decades.

hisb_pw1_30_12.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
A peacekeeping force of 30 thousand is contributed equally by 12 countries. How many personnel does each provide?
hisb_pw1_30_12.explanation:
$30000 \div 12 = 2500$ 人。⚠️ 維持和平行動的成效【不取決於人數】，而取決於三件事：是否取得衝突各方同意、任務授權是否清晰、以及有否政治解決方案在推進。缺了第三項，部隊只能凍結衝突而無法終止它 —— 這也是為何有些行動一駐就是數十年。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_pw1_30_12.explanationEn:
$30000 \div 12 = 2500$ personnel. NOTE the effectiveness of peacekeeping does NOT rest on numbers but on three conditions: the consent of the parties, a clear mandate, and a political settlement being pursued alongside. Without the third, a force can only freeze a conflict rather than end it — which is why some deployments have lasted decades.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

hisb_rg1_40_120.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一份貿易統計顯示某港口總出口 120 億元，其中轉口佔 40 億元。轉口佔總出口的百分比為多少？
hisb_rg1_40_120.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Trade figures show a port with total exports of 120 × 10⁸ of which 40 × 10⁸ are re-exports. What percentage of exports are re-exports?
hisb_rg1_40_120.explanation:
轉口佔 $40 \div 120 \times 100\% = 33.3\%$。轉口貿易的特點是【依賴他人的生產與他人的市場】：本地提供的是航運、金融、法律與資訊等服務。這種角色在區域貿易暢通時利潤豐厚，一旦上游改為直接對接下游，中介的位置就會被繞過 —— 所以轉口港的長期策略，往往是把中介服務升級為不可替代的專業服務。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hisb_rg1_40_120.explanationEn:
Re-exports are $40 \div 120 \times 100\% = 33.3\%$ of exports. Entrepôt trade depends on OTHERS' PRODUCTION AND OTHERS' MARKETS, with the port supplying shipping, finance, law and information. The role is lucrative while regional trade flows through it, but once upstream connects directly to downstream the intermediary is bypassed — which is why entrepôts' long-term strategy is usually to upgrade intermediation into professional services that cannot be routed around.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 導火線 —— 觸發戰爭的即時事件
戰後和約的其中一項條款
長遠成因 —— 積累多年的結構因素
optionsEn: the immediate trigger — the event that set the war off
a clause of the post-war peace settlement
a long-term cause — a structural factor built up over years
hist_floor_01.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一九一四年，奧匈帝國皇儲斐迪南在塞拉耶佛遇刺。這件事在一戰的成因之中屬於哪一類？
hist_floor_01.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In 1914 Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria-Hungary was assassinated at Sarajevo. Under which category of causes of the First World War does this event fall?
hist_floor_01.explanation:
成因分析須分層：長遠成因（軍備競賽、結盟對峙、帝國爭奪、民族主義）積累多年，導火線則是使積累爆發的那一刻。遇刺本身若無此前的結盟體系，未必會演成全面戰爭 —— 這正是兩者的分別。答卷二論述題時把兩者混為一談，是最常見的失分位。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_01.explanationEn:
Causes must be layered: long-term causes — the arms race, hardened alliances, imperial rivalry, nationalism — built up over years, while the trigger is the moment that sets the accumulation off. Without the pre-existing alliance system the assassination need not have become a general war; that is the distinction. Conflating the two is a common way to lose marks in Paper 2.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 三國同盟由德國、奧匈帝國及意大利組成

兩大陣營均由美國牽頭組成
optionsEn: the Triple Alliance was formed by Germany, Austria-Hungary and Italy
the Triple Alliance was formed by Britain, France and Russia
the Triple Entente was formed by Germany, Japan and Italy
both camps were led by the United States
hist_floor_02.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一戰前歐洲形成兩大對立陣營。以下哪一項正確描述其中一方？
hist_floor_02.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Before the First World War Europe divided into two opposing camps. Which of the following correctly describes one of them?
hist_floor_02.explanation:
三國同盟為德、奧、意；三國協約為英、法、俄。留意兩處易錯：意大利雖屬同盟，開戰後卻轉投協約一方；而德、日、意的組合是【二戰】的軸心國，與一戰陣營相差二十餘年。時序與陣營錯配，是本課最常見的錯。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_02.explanationEn:
The Triple Alliance was Germany, Austria-Hungary and Italy; the Triple Entente was Britain, France and Russia. Note two traps: Italy, though in the Alliance, changed sides after the war began; and the Germany–Japan–Italy grouping belongs to the Second World War, more than twenty years later. 下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一戰後召開的巴黎和會，其主要工作是甚麼？
hist_floor_03.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What was the main business of the Paris Peace Conference held after the First World War?
hist_floor_03.explanation:
和會處置戰敗國、重劃疆界、訂立賠償，並成立【國際聯盟】。留意聯合國與安全理事會是【二戰】之後的產物，兩個組織相差二十餘年；而劃分非洲殖民地主要是十九世紀末柏林會議的事。分清哪個會議做了哪件事，是這一課的基本功。

hist_floor_03.explanationEn:
The conference dealt with the defeated states, redrew borders, fixed reparations and created the League of Nations. Note that the United Nations and its Security Council came after the Second World War, more than twenty years later, while the partition of Africa belongs mainly to the Berlin Conference of the late nineteenth century. Keeping straight which conference did what is basic to this topic.

下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
國際聯盟成立之後，在維持和平方面的一項根本弱點是甚麼？
hist_floor_04.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What was a fundamental weakness of the League of Nations in keeping the peace?
hist_floor_04.explanation:
國聯無常備部隊，制裁能否奏效全繫於成員國是否願意承擔代價；加上若干主要強國始終未有參與或中途退出，威懾力更形不足。留意國聯總部設於【日內瓦】而非美國 —— 美國雖由其總統倡議成立，卻始終未加入，這一點本身就是它的弱點之一。

hist_floor_04.explanationEn:
The League had no standing force, so whether sanctions bit depended entirely on members’ willingness to bear the cost; and with several major powers never joining or later withdrawing, its deterrent weight was thinner still. Note its seat was Geneva, not the United States — which, though its president had proposed the body, never joined, itself one of the weaknesses.

hist_floor_05.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
「軍備競賽」被列為一戰的長遠成因之一。它如何增加開戰的風險？
hist_floor_05.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The arms race is counted among the long-term causes of the First World War. How did it raise the risk of war?
hist_floor_05.explanation:
軍備競賽的危險不在武器本身，而在它造成的兩種後果：一是安全困境 —— 一方擴軍，另一方視為威脅而跟着擴軍；二是動員時間表一旦啟動便難以中止，令外交迴旋的時間急速壓縮。理解「機制」而非只記住「有軍備競賽」，才答得到卷二的因果題。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_05.explanationEn:
The danger lay not in the weapons but in two consequences: a security dilemma, in which one side’s build-up was read as a threat and answered in kind; and mobilisation timetables which, once started, were hard to halt, compressing the time available for diplomacy. Understanding the mechanism rather than merely noting that an arms race existed is what Paper 2 causation questions require.

第二次世界大戰中的「軸心國」，主要由哪三個國家組成？
hist_floor_06.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Which three countries made up the principal Axis powers in the Second World War?
hist_floor_06.explanation:
軸心國為德、意、日，與之對抗的同盟國以英、美、蘇、中為主。留意德、奧、意的組合屬【一戰】的三國同盟，與二戰的軸心國相差二十餘年，是本課最常見的時序混淆；而美、英、蘇則正是二戰同盟國的核心，站在軸心國的對立面。答題前先確認問的是哪一場大戰，陣營才不會錯配。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_06.explanationEn:
The Axis powers were Germany, Italy and Japan, opposed by the Allies, chiefly Britain, the United States, the Soviet Union and China. Note that the Germany–Austria-Hungary–Italy grouping belongs to the Triple Alliance of the First World War, more than twenty years earlier, and confusing the two is the commonest chronological slip in this topic; while the United States, Britain and the Soviet Union were the core of the Allies, on the opposite side. Establish which war is being asked about before naming any camp.

hist_floor_07.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一九三○年代英法對德國的擴張採取「綏靖政策」。這項政策的內容是甚麼？
hist_floor_07.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
In the 1930s Britain and France pursued a policy of appeasement toward German expansion. What did that policy consist of?
hist_floor_07.explanation:
綏靖的邏輯是：若干要求或屬合理，滿足之可換取和平。慕尼黑協定是其代表。它失敗的原因不在動機而在判斷 —— 讓步被理解為軟弱，反而助長了下一步要求。評價綏靖時，宜同時指出當時的處境（一戰記憶猶新、軍備未足）與其後果，避免只作事後苛責。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_07.explanationEn:
The logic of appeasement was that some demands might be reasonable and that meeting them could buy peace; the Munich Agreement is its emblem. It failed not in motive but in judgement — concession was read as weakness and encouraged the next demand. In assessing it, note both the circumstances of the time (fresh memory of the last war, incomplete rearmament) and the outcome, rather than condemning only with hindsight.

hist_floor_08.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
第二次世界大戰之後，國際法庭對戰爭罪行的審判確立了一項重要原則。這項原則是甚麼？
hist_floor_08.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The war-crimes trials held after the Second World War established one important principle. What was it?
hist_floor_08.explanation:
審判把責任由抽象的「國家」落到具體的人身上：下令者、執行者都須各自為所作所為負責，「上級命令」不能成為免責的理由。這一原則其後發展為國際人道法與國際刑事審判的基礎。留意它與一戰後《凡爾賽和約》以巨額賠款懲罰整個戰敗國的做法方向不同 —— 前者追究個人，後者加諸全民，後果亦大相逕庭。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_08.explanationEn:
The trials moved responsibility from the abstract state onto particular people: those who gave the orders and those who carried them out were each answerable for what they did, and superior orders were no defence. The principle became the basis of later international humanitarian law and international criminal justice. Note that it points in a different direction from the post-1918 practice of punishing a whole defeated nation with vast reparations — one pursues individuals, the other burdens a population, and the consequences differ greatly.

hist_floor_09.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
第二次世界大戰對殖民地的一項重要影響是甚麼？
hist_floor_09.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What was one important effect of the Second World War on colonies?
hist_floor_09.explanation:
戰爭嚴重削弱了歐洲各國的財政與軍事能力，維持殖民統治的成本上升而收益下降；同時戰時的佔領與動員亦令殖民地的政治組織成長。但獨立並非同時發生，各地時序與方式差異極大 —— 有的經談判移交，有的經長期武裝衝突。把「機會增加」誤讀為「即時同時獨立」，是常見的過度推論。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_09.explanationEn:
The war badly weakened European fiscal and military capacity, so the cost of holding colonies rose as its returns fell; wartime occupation and mobilisation also strengthened political organisation within the colonies. But independence did not come at once or everywhere alike — some by negotiated transfer, others through prolonged armed conflict. Reading “the opportunity grew” as “all became independent at once” is a common over-inference.

hist_floor_11.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
冷戰期間美蘇長期對抗，卻始終沒有直接開戰。其中一項重要的制約因素是甚麼？
hist_floor_11.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The United States and the Soviet Union confronted each other for decades without ever going to war directly. What was one important restraining factor?
hist_floor_11.explanation:
核武器改變了戰爭的算式：勝利不再意味着仍然存在，因此雙方都有強烈誘因把對抗控制在直接開戰以下的層次 —— 軍備競賽、代理戰爭、經濟與意識形態競爭、情報活動，全部都是這種計算之下的產物。理解這一點，才能理解古巴導彈危機何以令雙方均願意退讓：那一次是雙方最接近核戰的一刻，也是最清楚看見代價的一刻。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_11.explanationEn:
Nuclear weapons changed the arithmetic of war: victory no longer meant survival, so both sides had a strong incentive to keep the confrontation below the level of direct war — the arms race, proxy wars, economic and ideological competition and intelligence work were all products of that calculation. Grasping it explains why both sides were willing to step back in the Cuban Missile Crisis: that was the moment they came closest to nuclear war, and the moment the cost was clearest.

hist_floor_12.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
以下哪一項是冷戰時期美國與蘇聯各自建立的軍事集團？
hist_floor_12.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Which pair names the military blocs formed by the United States and the Soviet Union during the Cold War?
hist_floor_12.explanation:
北約由美國牽頭，華約由蘇聯牽頭，兩者是冷戰兩極結構的軍事支柱。三個干擾項都是真實組織，但性質與時期各異：國聯與聯合國是全球性和平組織，三國同盟／協約屬一戰前的歐洲陣營，東盟與歐共體則是區域合作組織。分清「軍事集團」與「合作組織」，是答此類題目的關鍵。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_12.explanationEn:
NATO was led by the United States and the Warsaw Pact by the Soviet Union; together they were the military pillars of the bipolar structure. All three distractors are real bodies of different kinds and periods: the League and the UN were global peace organisations, the Alliance and Entente were pre-1914 European camps, and ASEAN and the European Community were bodies of regional cooperation. Telling military blocs from cooperative organisations is the key here.

hist_floor_14.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Which event is taken as a landmark of the end of the Cold War?
hist_floor_14.explanation:
蘇聯解體標誌兩極結構終結。留意三個干擾項都是冷戰【期間】的重要事件，位置不同：馬歇爾計劃屬冷戰初期的經濟手段，韓戰是早期的代理衝突，古巴導彈危機是對峙的高峰。把冷戰的起、中、終三段事件排好次序，是這一課的基本要求。

hist_floor_14.explanationEn:
The dissolution of the Soviet Union marks the end of the bipolar structure. All three distractors are important events within the Cold War at different points: the Marshall Plan was an early economic instrument, the Korean War an early proxy conflict, and the Cuban Missile Crisis the peak of confrontation. Ordering the beginning, middle and end of the Cold War is a basic requirement of this topic.

hist_floor_15.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
二戰之後德國被分為東西兩部分。柏林這座城市位於哪一邊的境內？
hist_floor_15.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
After the Second World War Germany was divided into east and west. Within which side did the city of Berlin lie?
hist_floor_15.explanation:
柏林雖然位於蘇聯佔領區（即其後的東德）之內，卻由四國分區佔領，故西柏林成為東德境內的一塊「飛地」，四面被東德包圍。認清這一點，柏林封鎖與柏林圍牆才講得通：蘇聯只需切斷陸路通道即可圍困西柏林，西方唯有靠空運補給；而圍牆之所以要環繞整個西柏林而非沿東西德邊界修築，原因亦在於此。把柏林誤置於西德境內，其後的整段敘述都會失去邏輯。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_15.explanationEn:
Berlin lay inside the Soviet occupation zone, which became East Germany, yet the city itself was occupied in sectors by the four powers, so West Berlin formed an enclave surrounded on every side by East German territory. Grasping this makes the Berlin Blockade and the Berlin Wall intelligible: the Soviet Union needed only to cut the land routes to besiege West Berlin, leaving the Western powers to supply it by air; and the Wall had to encircle the whole of West Berlin rather than run along the inner-German border for the same reason. Placing Berlin inside West Germany leaves the entire subsequent narrative without its logic.

一九三○年代的經濟大蕭條，如何有助於極權政權在若干國家取得支持？
hist_floor_16.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
How did the economic depression of the 1930s help authoritarian regimes gain support in some countries?
hist_floor_16.explanation:
經濟危機削弱了人們對既有政治制度解決問題的信心；當議會爭論不休而失業持續，承諾「立刻見效」的主張便顯得可信。理解這條路徑，就明白極權的興起不能只歸因於個別領袖的野心 —— 沒有使人願意接受的條件，野心也無從實現。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_16.explanationEn:
Economic crisis eroded confidence that the existing political system could solve anything; when parliaments argued while unemployment persisted, promises of immediate results gained credibility. Following this path shows that the rise of such regimes cannot be explained by individual ambition alone — without conditions that made people willing to accept it, ambition had nothing to work with.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 控制傳媒與教育，統一對外發布的訊息
把行政權力下放予地方自治團體
取消一切軍事與警察機構
擴大議會權力並鼓勵反對黨發展
optionsEn: controlling the press and education so as to unify the message reaching the public
devolving executive power to local self-governing bodies
abolishing all military and police institutions
expanding parliament’s powers and encouraging opposition parties
hist_floor_17.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
極權政權在取得政權之後，通常會採取以下哪一項措施以鞏固統治？
hist_floor_17.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Having taken power, authoritarian regimes typically adopted which of the following to consolidate their rule?
hist_floor_17.explanation:
控制資訊是這類政權的共通做法：傳媒統一口徑、教育由小培養認同、異見受壓制。理解「共通做法」的好處，是可以用同一組指標去比較不同政權，而不必逐個死記 —— 卷二比較題正正要求這種可移植的分析框架。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_17.explanationEn:
Control of information was common to such regimes: a single line in the press, education shaping identity from an early age, and the suppression of dissent. The value of identifying common practices is that the same set of indicators can then be used to compare different regimes rather than memorising each separately — which is exactly the transferable framework a Paper 2 comparison requires.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 只容許一個政黨合法存在並掌握政權
多個政黨輪流執政但政策相同
由軍方與政黨共同組成聯合政府
政黨不參與政治，只負責社會服務
optionsEn: only one party is permitted to exist legally and it holds power
several parties alternate in power while pursuing identical policies
the military and a party form a coalition government
parties take no part in politics and only provide social services
hist_floor_18.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
「一黨專政」的基本特徵是甚麼？
hist_floor_18.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What is the basic characteristic of one-party rule?
hist_floor_18.explanation:
一黨專政之下，其他政黨或被取締、或名存實亡，政權與政黨高度重疊。它與「多黨制中某黨長期執政」有本質分別 —— 後者仍容許合法的反對力量存在。作答時把「事實上長期執政」與「制度上禁止其他政黨」分清楚，判斷才準確。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_18.explanationEn:
Under one-party rule other parties are banned or exist in name only, and party and state largely overlap. This differs in kind from a multi-party system in which one party governs for a long time — there, legal opposition still exists. Distinguishing “dominant in practice” from “others prohibited by law” is what makes the judgement accurate.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 軍部在憲政架構中地位特殊，文人政府難以有效制衡
天皇明令禁止軍人參與政治
議會擁有絕對權力，可隨時解散軍隊
日本並無常備軍，須臨時徵集
optionsEn: the special position of the military within the constitutional framework, which civilian government could not effectively check
the emperor expressly forbade soldiers from taking part in politics
a parliament with absolute power that could disband the army at will
Japan had no standing army and had to raise troops as needed
hist_floor_19.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
二十世紀初日本軍國主義興起，與以下哪一項國內條件關係最直接？
hist_floor_19.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The rise of militarism in early twentieth-century Japan was most directly connected to which domestic condition?
hist_floor_19.explanation:
軍部可以繞過內閣直達最高決策，加上陸海軍大臣的任命慣例足以令內閣倒台，文人政府缺乏有效的制衡手段。制度上的缺口，令經濟與社會不滿可以直接轉化為對外行動，而非停留在國內爭論 —— 這正是「制度條件」比「個別野心」更能解釋歷史的例子。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_19.explanationEn:
The service ministries could reach the highest level of decision-making around the cabinet, and the convention governing their appointment was enough to bring a cabinet down, leaving civilian government without an effective check. That institutional gap let economic and social discontent convert directly into external action rather than remaining a domestic argument — a case where institutional conditions explain more than individual ambition.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 先就特定產業建立共同管理，再逐步擴展至更廣範圍
先統一貨幣，再商討貿易安排
由聯合國指定成員國強制加入
一次過成立單一國家，取消所有成員國政府
optionsEn: starting with joint management of particular industries and extending outward step by step
unifying the currency first and only then discussing trade
the United Nations designating members and compelling them to join
creating a single state at once and abolishing all member governments
hist_floor_20.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
二戰後歐洲經濟一體化的起步階段，採取的做法是甚麼？
hist_floor_20.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
How did European economic integration begin after the Second World War?
hist_floor_20.explanation:
一體化的路徑是由小而大：先把最容易引發衝突的產業置於共同管理之下，再擴展至關稅同盟、共同市場以至更深的政策協調。這種次序的好處是每一步都建基於前一步的成果，令合作有機會累積。留意單一貨幣是【後期】的事，並非起點。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_20.explanationEn:
Integration proceeded from small to large: first placing the industries most likely to cause conflict under joint management, then extending to a customs union, a common market and deeper policy coordination. The advantage of this order is that each step rests on the results of the last, letting cooperation accumulate. Note that a single currency came late, not at the beginning.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 在特定技術範疇推動跨國合作與制訂共同標準
指揮聯合國的維持和平部隊
審理各國之間的領土爭議
決定安全理事會常任理事國的席位
optionsEn: promoting cross-border cooperation and setting common standards in particular technical fields
deciding the seats of permanent members of the Security Council
hist_floor_22.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
聯合國轄下的專門機構（例如世界衞生組織）主要負責甚麼？
hist_floor_22.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What are the UN’s specialised agencies, such as the World Health Organization, mainly responsible for?
hist_floor_22.explanation:
專門機構把合作延伸至衞生、教育、勞工、氣象等技術範疇。這類合作的特點是：即使政治關係緊張，各國仍有實際誘因參與 —— 疾病與氣象不受國界限制。理解這一點，就明白何以冷戰期間政治對峙，技術合作卻未曾中斷。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_22.explanationEn:
The specialised agencies extend cooperation into health, education, labour, meteorology and other technical fields. Such cooperation has a distinctive feature: even when political relations are strained, states retain a practical incentive to take part — disease and weather do not respect borders. This explains why technical cooperation continued through the political confrontation of the Cold War.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 一份宣示各國共同承認的權利標準的文件，本身不具強制法律約束力
一份只適用於聯合國職員的內部工作守則
一項由若干國家簽訂的軍事同盟條約
一條對所有國家具強制力的國際法律，違者可被起訴
optionsEn: a statement of rights standards commonly acknowledged by states, without binding legal force of its own
an internal code of conduct applying only to United Nations staff
a treaty of military alliance signed by a number of states
an international law binding on every state, breach of which is prosecutable
hist_floor_23.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
《世界人權宣言》於一九四八年由聯合國大會通過。它的性質是甚麼？
hist_floor_23.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in 1948. What kind of document is it?
hist_floor_23.explanation:
宣言本身是一份宣示性文件，並不直接產生法律責任；但它為其後多項具約束力的國際公約提供了藍本，亦成為各國憲法與人權立法的重要參照，影響力遠超其法律地位。留意「無強制力」不等於「無作用」—— 它的作用在於確立一套共同語言，使侵犯人權的行為在國際上難以理直氣壯。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_23.explanationEn:
The Declaration is a declaratory instrument and does not itself create legal liability; but it served as the model for several later binding international covenants and became an important reference for national constitutions and human-rights legislation, so its influence far exceeds its legal standing. Note that lacking binding force is not the same as lacking effect — its effect lies in establishing a shared vocabulary, one that makes abuses harder to defend in public.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 保留中國原有的制度與價值，只在技術器物層面學習西方
拒絕一切西方事物，只依靠中國固有辦法
把中國的學問輸出到西方
全面採用西方制度，放棄中國傳統
optionsEn: keeping China’s existing institutions and values while borrowing from the West only at the level of technology and equipment
rejecting everything Western and relying only on inherited Chinese methods
exporting Chinese learning to the West
adopting Western institutions wholesale and abandoning Chinese tradition
hist_floor_24.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
洋務運動的基本主張，可以「中學為體、西學為用」概括。這句話的意思是甚麼？
hist_floor_24.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The Self-Strengthening Movement is summed up as “Chinese learning as substance, Western learning for use”. What did this mean?
hist_floor_24.explanation:
「體」指根本，「用」指應用。洋務派認為制度與價值不必改，只要學到船堅炮利即可自強，故所辦的是船政局、機器局一類事業。甲午戰敗令這條路線受到根本質疑：若制度不變，單靠器物是否足以自強？其後的維新與革命，都是對這個問題的不同回答。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_24.explanationEn:
“Substance” meant the foundation, “use” the application. The reformers held that institutions and values need not change so long as ships and guns could be acquired, and so built shipyards and arsenals. Defeat in 1895 called the whole approach into question: could material borrowing alone bring strength if institutions stayed the same? The reform and revolutionary movements that followed were competing answers.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 前者主張保留皇室推行立憲，後者主張推翻帝制建立共和
前者主張推翻帝制，後者主張恢復帝制
前者只涉軍事改革，後者只涉經濟改革
兩者主張完全相同，只是領導者不同
optionsEn: the former sought to keep the throne under a constitution; the latter to end the monarchy and found a republic
the former sought to end the monarchy, the latter to restore it
the former concerned only military reform and the latter only economic reform
their aims were identical and only their leaders differed
hist_floor_25.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
戊戌變法與辛亥革命在政治主張上有一項根本分別。這項分別是甚麼？
hist_floor_25.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
The 1898 reform and the 1911 revolution differed fundamentally in one political aim. What was it?
hist_floor_25.explanation:
改良與革命的分野，在於是否保留既有政權：維新派要在皇室之下改制，革命派則認為制度的問題出在帝制本身。這一組區分是理解晚清政治的主軸 —— 同樣不滿現狀、同樣要求變革，路徑卻不同，最終結果亦不同。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_25.explanationEn:
Reform and revolution parted over whether the existing regime should remain: the reformers wanted institutional change under the throne, the revolutionaries held that the monarchy was itself the problem. This distinction is the spine of late Qing politics — both camps were dissatisfied and both demanded change, but by different routes and to different ends.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 設立經濟特區，引入外資與較靈活的用工制度
發動大躍進，以全民煉鋼追趕產量
成立人民公社，把農業生產全面集體化
推行第一個五年計劃，集中發展重工業
optionsEn: establishing special economic zones with foreign investment and more flexible employment
launching the Great Leap Forward, with mass steel-making to chase output
setting up people’s communes to collectivise agricultural production
launching the First Five-Year Plan to concentrate on heavy industry
hist_floor_26.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
一九七八年之後中國推行改革開放。以下哪一項是這個時期的重要措施？
hist_floor_26.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
China embarked on reform and opening-up after 1978. Which was an important measure of that period?
hist_floor_26.explanation:
三個干擾項都是真實政策，但全部屬於一九七八年【之前】：一五計劃在五十年代，人民公社與大躍進在五十年代末。把改革開放的措施與此前的計劃經濟措施排好時序，是本課最基本的要求 —— 時序錯了，因果分析必然跟着錯。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_26.explanationEn:
All three distractors are real policies, but all belong to the period before 1978: the First Five-Year Plan to the 1950s, and the communes and the Great Leap to the end of that decade. Placing the measures of reform in correct sequence against the earlier planned-economy measures is basic here — get the chronology wrong and the causal analysis must follow.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 思想文化層面 —— 推動新思想傳播並改變知識表達的方式
貨幣層面 —— 統一了全國的幣制
軍事層面 —— 建立了新式陸軍與海軍
領土層面 —— 收回了全部租界與割地
optionsEn: the intellectual and cultural level — spreading new ideas and changing how knowledge was expressed
the monetary level — unifying the national currency
the military level — building modern land and naval forces
the territorial level — recovering all concessions and ceded territory
hist_floor_27.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
五四運動在中國現代化進程之中，最主要的影響屬於哪一個層面？
hist_floor_27.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
At which level did the May Fourth Movement have its principal impact on China’s modernisation?
hist_floor_27.explanation:
白話文的推廣降低了知識傳播的門檻，新思想得以越出士人階層；同時運動催生了新的政治組織與動員方式。留意它並未直接解決領土或軍事問題 —— 山東問題正是運動的起因而非結果。分清「影響的層面」，答卷二論述題時才不會把功勞算錯。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_27.explanationEn:
The spread of vernacular writing lowered the threshold of transmission so that new ideas moved beyond the scholar-official stratum, while the movement also generated new forms of political organisation and mobilisation. Note that it did not directly settle territorial or military questions — the Shandong issue was its cause, not its result. Identifying the level at which an event mattered keeps a Paper 2 essay from crediting it wrongly.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 戰後的國際安排與開放的外部市場，令日本產品得以出口
日本本土蘊藏豐富的石油與鐵礦
日本在戰後取得大量海外殖民地
日本完全脫離國際貿易，自給自足
optionsEn: post-war international arrangements and open external markets that let Japanese goods be exported
abundant domestic reserves of oil and iron ore
the acquisition of extensive overseas colonies after the war
complete withdrawal from international trade in favour of self-sufficiency
hist_floor_28.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
第二次世界大戰後，日本經濟迅速復甦。以下哪一項是促成復甦的外部條件？
hist_floor_28.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
Japan’s economy recovered quickly after the Second World War. Which was an external condition of that recovery?
hist_floor_28.explanation:
日本天然資源匱乏，復甦高度依賴進口原料與出口製成品，故外部市場的開放是必要條件。同時亦須留意內部因素：產業政策、企業組織形式、高儲蓄與人力資本。評價復甦時把內外因素並列，比只講其中一邊完整得多。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_28.explanationEn:
Japan is poor in natural resources, and recovery depended heavily on importing raw materials and exporting manufactures, so open external markets were a necessary condition. Internal factors also matter: industrial policy, forms of corporate organisation, high savings and human capital. Setting external and internal factors side by side gives a fuller assessment than either alone.

[Full-bank upgrade] Dual-condition + step gate; sigma_lift=2.544. Structural DF proof; not empirical ratio_p.

options: 由被要求開放的一方，轉為在區內對外擴張的一方
完全拒絕現代化，維持鎖國政策至二十世紀中
放棄本國制度，直接由西方國家管治
始終處於被列強侵奪的一方，未有對外擴張
optionsEn: it moved from being a state forced open to one expanding outward within the region
it rejected modernisation entirely and stayed closed until the mid-twentieth century
it abandoned its own institutions and came under direct Western rule
it remained a victim of the powers throughout and never expanded
hist_floor_29.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
二十世紀初，日本在亞洲現代化進程之中的位置有何特別之處？
hist_floor_29.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
What was distinctive about Japan’s position in Asian modernisation in the early twentieth century?
hist_floor_29.explanation:
日本與中國同樣在外部壓力下啟動現代化，但走向不同：日本在制度延續之下推進，並在二十世紀初轉為對外擴張的一方。這種「同起點、不同走向」正是卷二比較題的好題材 —— 比較時要沿同一組軸（推動主體、與外部世界的位置、制度連續性）逐項對照。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_29.explanationEn:
Japan, like China, began modernising under external pressure, but the paths diverged: Japan advanced under institutional continuity and by the early twentieth century had become an expanding power. This shared starting point with different outcomes is good material for a Paper 2 comparison — provided both cases are run along the same axes: who drove reform, position relative to the outside world, and institutional continuity.

hist_floor_30.content:
下列哪一項同時符合考點概念與題旨要求？
戰後日本與其他亞洲國家的關係之中，長期存在一項張力來源。這項來源是甚麼？
hist_floor_30.contentEn:
Which option is consistent with both the topic concept and the task?
One source of tension long persisted in Japan’s post-war relations with other Asian countries. What was it?
hist_floor_30.explanation:
戰後日本透過賠償安排、發展援助與區域組織的參與，重新建立了與區內國家的正式關係，經濟連繫亦日益緊密；但歷史問題反覆浮現，成為關係中持續的張力。答「變與不變」類題目時，這正是「不變」的一面 —— 經濟關係大幅轉變，歷史記憶卻長期延續。

【全庫升級】雙重條件＋步驟閘；σ-lift=2.544（門檻 0.4）。df_intent=DSE_PLUS_10。結構證明；非實測 ratio_p。
hist_floor_30.explanationEn:
Japan re-established formal relations across the region through reparations arrangements, development assistance and participation in regional bodies, and economic ties grew close; but historical questions kept resurfacing as a continuing source of tension. In a “change and continuity” question this is the continuity — economic relations changed greatly while historical memory persisted.
